title: starter-kit law carrier (code-as-law)
description: Laws ship as config: each row is a law with its why and its enforcement hook. law_gate.py validates this file and runs every machine-checkable enforcement. A law with enforcement 'prose' is legal but unenforced - the gate reports it as debt.

paid_for_by.description: the failure or correction that bred it (free text)

kind.description: check = machine-enforced by law_gate; prose = unenforced debt

check.description: named check the gate runs: gitignore-present, secrets-absent, profile-census-clean, receipts-before-claims
